# Lazy Plex Digital

> Lazy Plex Digital is the digital marketing services platform of Lazy Plex, serving businesses across industries in India. Clients can engage individual services including SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, social media, website development, lead generation, CRM and AI automation. This file is an optional editorial index; HTML pages and the XML sitemap are authoritative.

## Official websites and identity

- [Lazy Plex Digital](https://digital.lazyplex.com/): Overview of standalone digital marketing services and industry solutions.
- [About Lazy Plex Digital](https://digital.lazyplex.com/about/): Company approach and its founder, Suraj Kumar.
- [Lazy Plex main website](https://lazyplex.com/): Main business website, including real estate marketing.
- [Founder, Suraj Kumar](https://heysuraj.com/): The founder's personal site and projects.
- [Contact](https://digital.lazyplex.com/contact/): Request a scope or quotation.
